annotations.title: Make a receipt for a quotation

description: Check a quotation against the text and make a card built to be screenshotted and shared: the claim (who said what), the words quoted, the real text at its place (the original beside the English), a verdict (exact, near, not in the text or misattributed) and the permanent scriptura.si link. Give the quote, the claim if there is one ("Nietzsche said …") and the place in ref if you know it ("John 1:1", "Rep. 514a"). It uses check_quote where Scriptura has it, otherwise resolve_ref and read_work with a plain comparison, and says which. In hosts without apps the result is the same receipt as plain text.

claim.description: Who is said to have said it, e.g. "Plato said this about the cave".

ref.description: The place it is said to come from, e.g. "John 1:1" or "Rep. 514a".
